title: Fixes after the third audit: IPv6 address limits, erasing console helper data, help line
changes: Limits that count tries per internet address (wrong employee IDs, sign-in link failures, game starts, joins, payment-link tries) now treat all addresses inside one IPv6 home or phone network as one, so changing address no longer gives a fresh allowance. IPv4 works as before
When a game is deleted, the Host and Co-host roles made for it through the console (with the sealed e-mail address), its console sign-ins and any unopened console link are deleted too
Help now says that opening a game from your console signs you out of any other sign-in saved on this device
Nothing is deployed and no payment switch is on

title: The live game code is merged in: everything that is running now, plus the console Pay step
changes: This branch had missed 108 changes that are running live (live commit fa5ab0afa895, deployed 5 Nov 2026). They are now merged in, so a deploy of this branch drops nothing that is live
The live rule for employee IDs (it depends on when the game was made) is kept, and the older-list fix from 1.4.2 still works on top of it

The live limit of 2,000 people per game, the live wording about credit, and the live report timing (link works 19 hours, names deleted at 20 hours) are kept; the screens still speak to you and use the rupee sign
The two database files added by this branch are renamed 0032 and 0033, because live already uses 0030 and 0031
Nothing about payment is switched on

title: Fixes from the audits: a console sign-in for one game stays in its own tab, payments cannot be counted twice, old employee lists still work
changes: A sign-in the console opens for one game now stays in that browser tab only. It is not saved on the device, and an older saved sign-in can no longer take its place
Sign out in that tab now ends the key straight away
A second, different payment for a game that is already paid is now refused instead of being accepted
Employee lists made before version 1.4.1 still work when a person types the ID the way the list holds it
The help for organizers now speaks to you everywhere, and says plainly that an employee ID is checked against your list but does not prove who typed it
Nothing about payment is switched on

title: Checked before the audit: employee IDs, plain wording for organizers, safer console keys
changes: An employee ID is now read one way everywhere: A-1101, A 1101 and A/1101 are the same person
The organizer and host screens now speak to you, show money with the rupee sign, and carry one privacy line and one fairness sentence
A console sign-in made for one game can no longer cause an error by opening a broken address; it is simply refused
Nothing about payment is switched on: the console's Pay step and the old-link redirect stay off

title: Ready for the console's one Pay step (switched off)
changes: The console can now ask this game who owns a game and what size it is (payInfo) and tell it that the game is paid (markPaid, safe to repeat); only that notice unlocks the start. Nothing changes for anyone until the owner switches the console's payment on
The old Pay now link keeps working exactly as before; with the switch PAY_VIA_CONSOLE set to 1 it sends people to the console instead
Security rules: only the organizer page may show the secure payment window and talk to the console

title: Bigger daily write guard
changes: The daily database-write guard is raised to 2,000,000 (a runaway guard only), because the account is on the paid Workers plan

title: Same hardening as Corporate Tambola 1.3.3: joining, permissions, messages, simpler console
changes: Joining: an employee ID or mobile number is checked against the organizer's list (or either of them), a stranger waits for the organizer's yes, one phone cannot play as another (device proof on every place action), the same person joining twice gets the same place
A join that gets no answer (slow link, busy moment) is asked again by itself, safe because the same person always gets the same place
Permissions: a Co-host who has not accepted the terms cannot pay or use credit, an erase is refused while the tournament is being played, a forged vote or game-over report is refused
A game published but not paid never blocks a new game: only never-published drafts count towards the ten

Simpler console: radio buttons and check boxes, a plain sentence under the main options, a live line with the choice so far, what not to do and why on every step; the rarely used 'What must a person give to get in?' choice is hidden, never disabled, until staff-only is ticked
A demo link (zc.html?pass=) is used once, also when the console opens straight into a game
Players' data is deleted 20 hours after the end (the promise stays 24 hours) and a lazy tick runs the housekeeping when the scheduled job is late
Every refusal now says what happened, where, and how to fix it (guide catalog)
Big screen shows 'Connection lost' when the server does not answer for 15 seconds
The public random beacon can be reached through our own server when a company firewall blocks it

title: One-door sign-in, protected pages, step state in the console
changes: One sign-in door for Organizers and Hosts with a six-box code screen, e-mail first on the console card
Shipped scripts are minified, AI crawlers are told not to read the product, Terms 2.4
The console keeps the state of each step

title: Owner desk, rights, colour, installable app
changes: Owner desk: site switch, organizer lookup, data requests, error signal
Players can leave and ask for their data
Vivid colours, short animations, installable app
Ledger C: every payment attempt posted to the central service

title: Corporate Tic Tac Toe goes up
changes: Knockout tournament of tic tac toe boards, played one against one or in teams; the phones play and the server is only a mailbox
A sealed draw anyone can check, a champion and final places with no ties
Payment through the central payment service, report by e-mail
